subject: English
question_text: What are the problems with nonrenewable energy?
guide_solution: Non-renewable energy sources like petroleum, coal, and natural gas have several problems. Firstly, they are finite energy resources and the world eventually will run out of them. Secondly, they will become too expensive in the coming decades and too damaging for the environment. Thirdly, fossil fuels have direct polluting impacts on earth's environment causing global warming.
source: SSC English 1st-paper Amena-Baki Residential Model School & College, Dinajpur (Made Easy SQ) 2024

subject: English
question_text: What are the major differences between renewable and non-renewable energy sources?
guide_solution: Renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind energy, are naturally replenished and never run out. On the other hand, non-renewable energy sources, like fossil fuels, are finite and will deplete over time.
source: SSC English 1st-paper Amena-Baki Residential Model School & College, Dinajpur (Made Easy SQ) 2024

subject: English
question_text: How can ocean energy be a substitution to run out non-renewable energy?
guide_solution: Ocean energy can be a substitution to non-renewable energy. Ocean's force of tide and wave can be used to produce energy. Technologies such as tidal and wave power capture the energy from the movement of water and generate clean, renewable electricity.
